image_alt: A whippet runs towards the camera through a thick carpet of orange autumn leaves beneath tall beech trees.

text.facebook: Nearly two in three dog owners don't recognise acorns as a danger, Dogs Trust found. PDSA says green acorns are the most toxic, conkers can block the gut, and fungi are hard to tell apart, so it's best to stop your dog eating any. My tip: carry a high-value treat and practise swap and drop, tossing the treat so your dog drops what they've picked up. What to look out for on Forest walks this autumn: https://www.foresthounds.co.uk/blog/acorns-conkers-and-dogs
